Project #19
Standalone Root Cause Analysis
Progress Since July 2026

text: Progress through 22 September 2026

Progress update based on project records available through 22 September 2026. Standalone RCA scope only. Source: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Downloads/S&T_PTC_July2026Presentation.pptx, slides 7–13; /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Try 7/TRY7_EXECUTIVE_PLAN.md, section 10 implementation receipt and smoke outcome; /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Synthetic Evidence Packages 2026-09-22/README_OPERATOR_ONLY.md. The date is the evidence cutoff, not a confirmed meeting date.
Progress Since July
Step-by-step RCA
Built iterative investigations with specialist questions, evidence references and preserved investigation versions.
textPreview: Built iterative investigations with specialist questions, evidence references and preserved investigation versions.

text: Validate incident RCA
Ran development experiments on the R3 beam and instrument-air cases. Prepared staged synthetic evidence packages.
textPreview: Ran development experiments on the R3 beam and instrument-air cases. Prepared staged synthetic evidence packages.

text: Test open-source models
Ran Qwen through real investigation workflows. Reliability and causal accuracy remain under evaluation.
textPreview: Ran Qwen through real investigation workflows. Reliability and causal accuracy remain under evaluation.

text: July baseline: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Downloads/S&T_PTC_July2026Presentation.pptx, slides 7–13. Current evidence: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/RCA_RESEARCH_OVERVIEW_AND_PLAN.md, sections 5 and 8; /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Try 7/TRY7_EXECUTIVE_PLAN.md, section 10 implementation receipt and smoke outcome; /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Synthetic Evidence Packages 2026-09-22/README_OPERATOR_ONLY.md. July already described a prototype and methodology. Do not imply the project began from zero after July.
Iterative Investigation Prototype
Establish the incident
Register the narrative and documents, identify relevant entities, and form preliminary explanations.
textPreview: Register the narrative and documents, identify relevant entities, and form preliminary explanations.

text: Investigate open questions
Consult relevant specialists, combine overlapping requests, and route source-backed answers to their owners.
textPreview: Consult relevant specialists, combine overlapping requests, and route source-backed answers to their owners.

text: Review and revise
Assess factual support, causal roles and connections separately. Save the current board and unresolved questions.
textPreview: Assess factual support, causal roles and connections separately. Save the current board and unresolved questions.

text: Sources: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/RCA_RESEARCH_OVERVIEW_AND_PLAN.md, sections 5 and 8; /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Try 7/TRY7_EXECUTIVE_PLAN.md, section 10 implementation receipt and smoke outcome. Application versions (Try 4–7) differ from investigation snapshots (V1–V3).
Findings from Development Runs
Earlier causal pipelines
Produced visible boards, but expanding context and candidate links could block completion or create excessive work.
textPreview: Produced visible boards, but expanding context and candidate links could block completion or create excessive work.

text: Persistent task engine
Improved recovery and inspection. Completing the workflow still did not guarantee a useful causal explanation.
textPreview: Improved recovery and inspection. Completing the workflow still did not guarantee a useful causal explanation.

text: Evidence revisions
Published V1 and V2, but some corrections failed to reach board wording and some questions remained stale.
textPreview: Published V1 and V2, but some corrections failed to reach board wording and some questions remained stale.

These experiments used changing inputs and configurations. They are development observations, not a controlled ranking of versions. Try 4 includes saved R3 versions and IA runs; Try 5 comparison snapshots were diagnostic; Try 6 published a partial IA V1/V2 pair.
Recent RCA System Improvements
Evidence and questions
Track partial answers and subscriber delivery. Preserve different question purposes and expose reviewer questions.
textPreview: Track partial answers and subscriber delivery. Preserve different question purposes and expose reviewer questions.

text: Corrections and review
Apply source-bound revisions with history. Separate factual support from causal-role and relationship judgments.
textPreview: Apply source-bound revisions with history. Separate factual support from causal-role and relationship judgments.

text: Reproducible records
Preserve snapshots, controlled-release receipts and experiment exports. The receipt reports 97 software checks passed.

These are recorded checks, not checks rerun for this presentation. Full-plan acceptance remains incomplete.

text: Source: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Try 7/TRY7_EXECUTIVE_PLAN.md, section 10 implementation receipt and smoke outcome, Observed smoke outcome. Published 20 September 2026 at 8:17:54 PM America/Chicago. Real provider run on a short pneumatic-carriage incident, not the historical benchmark. 21 tasks completed, zero failed/blocked whole tasks. V1 contained 5 selected observations plus a focal event and zero causal links. 20 rejected output items remained preserved; one delivery receipt was pending in the saved snapshot. Configuration changes and a checkpoint repair occurred during the run. Post-run fixes passed scripted tests but await a fresh frozen-config model run.
Staged Evidence Packages
R3 carrier-beam fall
Staged reconstruction prepared. Load-path and circuit details require independent technical review before scoring.
textPreview: Staged reconstruction prepared. Load-path and circuit details require independent technical review before scoring.

text: Instrument-air loss
Package prepared for a pilot, with configuration, pressure observations and operating chronology across documents.
textPreview: Package prepared for a pilot, with configuration, pressure observations and operating chronology across documents.

text: Three evidence releases
Starter evidence supports V1. Later documents test whether V2 and V3 revise explanations for justified reasons.
textPreview: Starter evidence supports V1. Later documents test whether V2 and V3 revise explanations for justified reasons.

text: Synthetic reconstructions of development cases. Independent validation remains pending.

text: Source: /Users/dhwanilchauhan/Desktop/RCA Try 1/Synthetic Evidence Packages 2026-09-22/README_OPERATOR_ONLY.md. Packages generated 22 September 2026. Both are historically anchored synthetic reconstructions, not recovered company records. They are derivatives of development incidents already used and are not independent held-out cases. No RCA or storyteller jobs had been launched for these packages in the source record. R3 requires technical review; IA is prepared for pilot and is not independently expert validated.
Next Steps: Controlled Investigation
Freeze and run
Fix the model, prompts and evidence schedule. Preserve each version and the inputs that produced it.

text: Assess the changes
Check factual accuracy, causal support, uncertainty and correction quality. Report software failures separately.

Run a simpler baseline on the same evidence. Seek technical review of case realism and causal interpretations.
